subject: The one feature 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: You've had the app for 3 weeks. There's a secret weapon you're not using. It changes everything.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was looking at your usage data. You're checking predictions, scanning stats, doing the basics. But you're missing the one thing that separates casual fans from absolute sharks. The feature that turns 'maybe' into 'definitely'.

For three weeks, you've been playing with half the toolbox. Imagine knowing not just WHAT will happen in tomorrow's derby, but EXACTLY WHY. Not just the predicted score, but the precise weakness in the defense, the exact attacking pattern that will break through, the single player matchup that decides everything. That's the difference between guessing and knowing.

Head-to-head history and tactical analysis. It's not just past scores. It's our AI dissecting thousands of tactical variables: how Team A's high press crumbles against Team B's long-ball specialist, how a specific left-back always gets roasted by that winger, how the manager's subs change the game in the 70th minute. This is the secret layer. The 'how' behind the 'what'.

Open Predictify right now. Tap into any upcoming match and scroll past the confidence score. Find the 'Tactical Breakdown' section. Spend 60 seconds there before your next match. You'll never watch football the same way again. P.S. Premium users get this breakdown for EVERY match, plus the 'Key Matchup' alert that pings you 1 hour before kickoff with the one battle that decides the game. The 3-day trial is still there if you want the full arsenal.
